name: Vigga
title: The Axe-Smith
examine: Every tooth in this town comes off her stone. She hangs axe-heads the way other smiths sign their work, and can tell whose axe it is by the wear.
lines: Bring it before it chips, not after. After is a new head and a new price.
The boom chain is one job and it takes me a fortnight. Ask Kettil what happens when it goes.
Wedges. Everyone forgets wedges until the tree sits down on the blade.
